parameters.name: X-Glean-Include-Experimental
parameters.description: This endpoint is in beta, so requests must include this header set to `true`. See [How beta APIs work](https://developers.glean.com/beta/overview) for details.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: The ID of the chat to resume.

parameters.name: last_seen_sequence_id
parameters.description: The `sequence_id` of the last event already received. The stream continues with the next event. Defaults to 0, which starts from the beginning.
